_doc: Which engine each TMEC bot thinks with, read by engines/route.py. grokbot: the bot's own run does the thinking and route.py calls nothing. claude: Claude Code CLI on Tommy's Claude plan. codex: Codex CLI on a ChatGPT plan. Whether Tommy has a ChatGPT plan is not known (2026-11-16), so every codex bot falls back to claude, and route.py does that by itself when the codex CLI is not installed. Nothing in the pack calls route.py yet: see docs/ENGINES.md.
